notes.title: A Game About Flying, SkyPoints, and Powerups!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=5EJy3P6MHq4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]How did *Super Cloud Fight* come to be?[/h1]

Ole Goethe, an associate professor in game design, develops a video game every 5-6 years to stay current with new technologies and trends. This hands-on approach allows him to integrate the latest advancements into his teaching and professional practice. And so, it began. Concepting, rapid prototyping phases, and a fully functional game emerged in record time.

[h1]Why flying?[/h1]

Our small team’s love for speed without boundaries and combat games inspired the concept of aerial combat with customizable planes and unique maneuvers. We wanted to bring the intensity of dogfights into a format that’s easy to pick up, just like a battle royale. The goal was to create a game that’s both competitive and fun for everyone. Although it was grand ideas, the team envisioned blending the dynamic feel of Super Mario Kart, Fortnite, and Overwatch to immerse players in a fast-paced, thrilling experience that feels just right. Time will tell if we made it!!

[h1]What do you actually do in the game?
[/h1]

Engage in Aerial Combat 🛩️ > Collect SkyPoints 🎮 > Upgrade Your Plane ⚙️ > Customize Appearance 🎨 > Compete in Sky Battle Matches 🏆 > Unlock New Characters and Levels 🔓

That’s the loop. And that’s exactly what makes the game so entertaining – it’s simple, yet incredibly fun.
